post.summary: Explain fields in an exact workflow snapshot
post.description: Requires workflows.manage and forms.manage. Reads only the named workflow revision, the explicitly named start form version, pinned human forms and accessible pinned subprocesses. Returns a bounded, sorted field table with technical dependency evidence, source snapshots, diagnostics, summary counts and conservative review suggestions. No form is changed and no business handler, provider or submission is executed. A missing start form is excluded rather than resolved to a latest version. Stale version references fail; inaccessible workflow or subprocess detail is not exposed. Example request: {"workflow_version_ref_id":"<exact-ref>","start_form_version_ref_id":"<exact-ref>","locale":"fa","page":1,"size":25}.

post.description: Creates a new root and independent draft from an exact published form or workflow version. COPY embeds the source's resolved form document; REFERENCE retains exact reusable component or subprocess pins and revalidates current grants. Both modes persist source_ref_id, source_checksum and mode as provenance. Example: {"kind":"form","source_ref_id":"<exact-ref>","code":"purchase_copy","name":"Purchase copy","mode":"COPY"}. REFERENCE example: {"kind":"workflow","source_ref_id":"<published-workflow-ref>","code":"approval_draft","name":"Approval draft","mode":"REFERENCE"}. New references to retired or inaccessible dependencies fail.

Returns at most 32 issues and 32 warnings with JSON pointers; warnings do not make draft valid false. Locale and format_values are preview-only inputs. Versioned bpms.messages/1 catalogs support en/fa, named typed parameters and one/other plurals. Draft validation reports missing or stale translations in warnings and returns source_revisions for translation acknowledgement. Publication requires every required-locale message and matching parameter types. Default text hashes track stale translations; published versions remain immutable. Null catalogs preserve legacy checksums. Field bpms.format/1 metadata declares direction, Gregorian calendar, IANA timezone, Latin/Persian digits and exact decimal/currency formatting. Canonical submission strings use Gregorian ISO dates, UTC datetimes and ungrouped decimals; localized or lossy values are rejected.

post.description: Requires forms.manage. Conditions combine with client/range targets; version_in_range uses numeric release ordering. Shared design is the final fallback, including legacy clients unless a condition explicitly matches their null identity. Caller headers cannot replace the bound context or grant access. Returns page JSON, variant key and design revision. Expression issues include document pointer, one-based line and zero-based column. Evaluation errors or missing required renderer capabilities fail selection; they do not silently choose another branch. Preview does not publish or modify an interaction. Resolves message roles and option labels into a presentation copy using locale or Accept-Language. Regional tags use en/fa; unsupported locales fall back to the package default. Missing optional translations fall back to default then English; resolved locale is reported per message. format_values contains up to 32 node_pointer/value samples: returns exact canonical/display strings without changing data. Bad samples return valid false with localization.format_value. Design revision is stable across locale switches; catalog_revision changes when content changes. Responses use Cache-Control: private, no-store. Versioned bpms.messages/1 catalogs support en/fa, named typed parameters and one/other plurals. parameters.description: Optional caller-controlled client software identifier for audit and diagnostics; captured up to 1024 characters. Browsers supply their own value and may ignore manual Swagger overrides. Not trusted client identity or authorization.

parameters.name: Date
parameters.description: Optional RFC 9110 HTTP-date generated by native clients for advisory diagnostics. Browser JavaScript cannot set Date. Missing or invalid values do not reject the request.

parameters.name: Accept-Language
parameters.description: Optional preferred response language. English and Farsi are supported; regional tags use their base language and unsupported values fall back to English.

parameters.name: X-Request-ID
parameters.description: Optional UUIDv7 correlation identifier. Missing or invalid values are replaced with a generated UUIDv7; the effective value is returned in X-Request-ID.

parameters.name: X-Audit-Reason
parameters.description: Optional caller-supplied reason recorded in audit history. It is not an authorization credential.

X-Client-Date-Status.description: Optional client Date reading: available, unavailable, or invalid. No request is rejected for this diagnostic.

X-Client-Date-Delta-Seconds.description: Signed server receipt minus client Date in seconds; includes transit and generation delay, so it is not exact clock skew.

X-Client-Date-Advisory.description: Present as check-device-time only when the configured apparent difference threshold is reached.

X-Server-Received-At.description: Server UTC receipt timestamp. Response Date, when present, is generated by the HTTP server or proxy.

get.summary: Read a policy-filtered pinned human-task view
get.description: Requires requests.start and current work-item visibility. The named edit, summary or print view composes with the submission's pinned client variant and current locale. Read policy filters data, prior review data, feedback and render nodes; presentation visibility never grants write permission. Autosave uses the revision-bearing work-item ref and stale writes fail with VERSION_CONFLICT. Unsaved navigation requires a client warning. Private no-store response.

post.summary: Approve or deny a claimed AI tool call
post.description: Requires requests.start and the current eligible claimant. Only a PENDING approval on a current CLAIMED/IN_PROGRESS work-item reference may change. approved=true atomically completes the work item and stages one worker resume in the existing outbox; it does not execute the tool in the HTTP request. approved=false rejects the item, deletes its encrypted payload and fails the AI attempt. A repeated identical command before process advancement is a no-op; a changed command payload, stale reference, terminal execution or expired approval returns 409. Approval uses the task's existing elapsed/token/USD budget. The worker rechecks execution state, connection and query permissions; unknown dispatch is fenced against replay. Tool approvals cannot be forwarded.

AIAgentDraftSpec-Input.title: AIAgentDraftSpec
AIAgentDraftSpec-Input.description: Author-controlled values. All references are resolved at publication.

AIAgentDraftSpec-Output.title: AIAgentDraftSpec
AIAgentDraftSpec-Output.description: Author-controlled values. All references are resolved at publication.

tool_versions.title: Tool Versions
tool_versions.description: Trusted tool key to immutable deployed version, resolved at publication; empty for tool-free agents.

account.title: Account
account.description: Required account identifier for Snowflake or OpenAI Codex connections. ASCII letters, digits, underscores and hyphens only; never credentials.

approved.title: Approved
approved.description: True authorizes the exact displayed read-only call once; false denies it and fails this AI attempt.

command_key.title: Command Key
command_key.description: Client-generated idempotency key for this decision. Reuse only with the identical decision on the same work item.

work_item_ref.title: Work Item Ref
work_item_ref.description: Current version-bearing work-item reference; claim it through the normal work-item API before inspecting or deciding the tool call.

status.title: Status
status.description: Durable approval state. CONSUMED fences dispatch; it does not itself prove the model completed. DENIED, EXPIRED and CANCELLED cannot resume.

tool_key.title: Tool Key
tool_key.description: Allowlisted trusted tool selected by the model; never a Python import or arbitrary SQL.

tool_version.title: Tool Version
tool_version.description: Immutable deployed tool version pinned when the agent was published.

arguments.title: Arguments
arguments.description: Exact validated named tool arguments, available only to the eligible claimant before expiry/consumption. For lookup_saved_report: report_ref is an owned saved report reference and limit is an integer from 1 to 10. Null after payload deletion; contains no message history.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: UTC deadline derived from the logical task elapsed-time budget, including human approval time.

decided_at.title: Decided At
decided_at.description: UTC decision time, or null before a claimant decision.

design_snapshot.title: Design Snapshot
design_snapshot.description: Pinned client variant and interaction revision with locale-resolved presentation text. Reads resolve the exact pinned form catalog using Accept-Language without rewriting audit snapshots or canonical data. localization reports resolved_locale, direction, catalog_revision and per-message locale/source_revision. Option values and outcomes remain canonical. Authorized responses are private, no-store; locale changes never select a different variant.

text.title: Text
text.description: Plain text with named {parameters}, or exactly one/other branches selected by integer count. No HTML, ICU, format specifiers or executable templates.

source_revision.title: Source Revision
source_revision.description: Translation acknowledgement of the default message SHA-256 revision returned by validation/preview. Missing or old acknowledgements are draft gaps and block required-locale publication.

source.title: Source
source.description: User input, process context, constant, or earlier step output; no profile source is inferred from a label.

DependencyHealth.title: DependencyHealth
DependencyHealth.description: Health status and latency for one internal dependency.

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description: Localized failure with a stable application error number.

EventDeliveryDTO.title: EventDeliveryDTO
EventDeliveryDTO.description: Validated input shared by authenticated webhook and message adapters.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Stable technical consumer reason code; see the field inventory guide.

location.title: Location
location.description: Exact source definition pointer, prefixed by collection point for form documents.

via.title: Via
via.description: Intermediate calculated field identities in a transitive dependency chain.

workflow_version_ref_id.title: Workflow Version Ref Id
workflow_version_ref_id.description: Exact draft revision or published workflow version reference; stale revisions fail.

start_form_version_ref_id.title: Start Form Version Ref Id
start_form_version_ref_id.description: Exact start form version for this analysis. Omitted means no start form is analyzed; latest is never selected.

complete.title: Complete
complete.description: False when opaque, inaccessible, missing, dynamic or bounded dependencies prevent an unused claim.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Bounded coverage diagnostics; review these before acting on suggestions.

declared_ports.title: Declared Ports
declared_ports.description: Typed step and subprocess interface ports, including unbound declarations.

resolved_pins.title: Resolved Pins
resolved_pins.description: Accessible exact component, data-type and child workflow versions analyzed.

identity.title: Identity
identity.description: Form version, collection point and JSON Schema scope; duplicate labels do not merge identities.

source.title: Source
source.description: Declared origin such as USER_INPUT, DEFAULT, COMPUTATION, HOST_NAVIGATION or EARLIER_TASK_OUTPUT.

user_entry.title: User Entry
user_entry.description: Whether this collection point permits a user entry; read-only review does not count.

classification.title: Classification
classification.description: Conservative requiredness/use category for the analyzed definition set.

dependencies.title: Dependencies
dependencies.description: Direct and transitive uses, each with reason, location and localized explanation.

suggestions.title: Suggestions
suggestions.description: Evidence-backed prompts for human review; never proof a field can be deleted.

field_definitions.title: Field Definitions
field_definitions.description: Field definitions across collection points; not runtime collection row count.

unique_field_definitions.title: Unique Field Definitions
unique_field_definitions.description: Distinct form-version/schema-scope pairs across collection points.

possible_user_inputs.title: Possible User Inputs
possible_user_inputs.description: Editable collection-point definitions over all analyzed branches; not a universal minimum.

code.title: Code
code.description: Stable review-candidate code, not an automatic removal instruction.

FilterCriteria.title: FilterCriteria
FilterCriteria.description: One filter in the shared search wire format.

FilterOperation.title: FilterOperation
FilterOperation.description: Filter operators exposed by the shared search contract.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: Descending branch order; the first matching variant wins. Shared design is the final fallback.

condition.title: Condition
condition.description: Optional boolean expression over the declared client namespace, combined with client/range targets. Uses version_in_range(client.release, minimum, maximum_exclusive) for numeric releases; bounds are literal versions or null. Missing releases do not match. Errors fail selection. No request data, scripts or authorization grants. Null preserves legacy targeting.

render_schema.title: Render Schema
render_schema.description: Bounded bpms.render/1 document; POST /forms/render-schema returns its complete typed JSON Schema including messages, option_messages and bpms.format/1 field formatting. Message roles resolve to localized_text, localized_options and compatibility label/placeholder/accessibility fields in runtime views.

reuse_instances.title: Reuse Instances
reuse_instances.description: Exact authored component version references placed in empty render placeholders. Published versions pin fully resolved data/render snapshots and their transitive manifest.

localization.description: Optional bpms.messages/1 catalog pinned with this exact version. Null preserves legacy reads and checksums. Draft gaps are warnings; required translations and matching parameters are mandatory at publication.

catalogs.title: Catalogs
catalogs.description: Versioned administrator-authored catalogs, at most 256 messages per locale and 64 KiB in total. Regional requests fall back to their base language, then package default, then English.

node_pointer.title: Node Pointer

value.title: Value

GraphFlow.title: GraphFlow
GraphFlow.description: Optional advanced control-flow policy; absent means legacy single-path behavior.

interface.description: Reusable published workflow interface; null preserves ordinary workflow behavior.

subprocess.description: Pinned child call on a SUBPROCESS step. Execution uses the exact published version and isolated mapped inputs.

condition.description: Boolean expression over declared request/process/reachable outputs and saved origin client. Use version_in_range(client.release, literal_minimum, literal_maximum_exclusive) for releases. Null is unconditional; errors stop progression.

is_default.title: Is Default
is_default.description: Final else for this source/outcome, used only when no non-default matches. At most one; client-aware groups require an unconditional default below all branch priorities.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: Descending if/elif order within a source/outcome. Duplicate priorities are invalid. First matching non-default wins outside explicit parallel split policy.

LibrarySelectQuery.title: LibrarySelectQuery
LibrarySelectQuery.description: Filter one authored resource kind for a bounded key/value picker.

documents.description: Bounded canonical draft documents; validated before source resolution. The authenticated client selects the variant.

node_pointer.title: Node Pointer
node_pointer.description: Node JSON pointer in the selected render document, for example /root/children/1.

data.title: Data
data.description: Current unsaved canonical values for dependency bindings. Submission independently rechecks persisted values.

row_indices.title: Row Indices
row_indices.description: Outer-to-inner indices for repeated item scopes.

selected_keys.title: Selected Keys
selected_keys.description: Optional json-scalar/1 encoded keys for selected-value lookup through the same visibility filters.

generation.title: Generation
generation.description: Caller generation echoed verbatim. Apply results only when generation, dependency fingerprint and source revision still match the active control.
